title: Better Than Ponosik
body:
**READ WIKI BEFORE PLAYING THE MOD!**

A mod that insipired "Better Than Wolves". Mod makes game harder! Almost everything from vanilla is not changed except the most common things. This mod adds real life items like sharp stick, sharp stone, bat and other many things! Ando also make progress harder. If you like _**hard**_ mods, this mod is right for you! P.S 1 Iron ore gives you 1 iron nugget lol
